definitions.explanation: An actor whose work is in films rather than on stage or television. Used of both men and women, though {女優|じょゆう} is the usual word when the gender is being specified.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{映画俳優|えいがはいゆう}だった。
examples.english: My father was a movie actor.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どものころから{映画俳優|えいがはいゆう}に{憧|あこが}れていた。
examples.english: I had looked up to movie actors since childhood.

examples.japanese: {舞台|ぶたい}で{経験|けいけん}を{積|つ}んだあと、{三十歳|さんじゅっさい}で{映画俳優|えいがはいゆう}として{世|よ}に{出|で}た。
examples.english: After gaining experience on the stage, he made his name as a film actor at thirty.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {映画俳優|えいがはいゆう}になる: to become a film actor
- {人気|にんき}の{映画俳優|えいがはいゆう}: a popular film actor
- {映画俳優|えいがはいゆう}を{目指|めざ}す: to aim to be a film actor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {俳優|はいゆう}: actor — the general term, covering stage, film, and television
- {女優|じょゆう}: actress — used far more often than {映画俳優|えいがはいゆう} for women
- {役者|やくしゃ}: actor — traditional and slightly old-fashioned, with a stage flavor
- スター: star — fame rather than profession
